intent: The garden's movement final: spring bounces, a crumble causeway, lift boards, a low blossom-ceiling hop corridor, waterfall updrafts and a dash switchback — every exam in sequence. Expert redesign: garden gates and hanging flower baskets.

sections.name: The waking garden
sections.lesson: Bounce into the garden · aim for the stone landing. Read the latch; dash through as the gate opens.

signs.text:
The waking garden
Read the latch; dash through as the gate opens.

sections.name: The fragile trellis
sections.lesson: Cross the crumble causeway · no leaf waits. Read the latch; dash through as the gate opens.

signs.text:
The fragile trellis
Read the latch; dash through as the gate opens.

sections.name: The gardener’s lift
sections.lesson: Ride the garden lift onto the high terrace. Read the latch; dash through as the gate opens.

signs.text:
The gardener’s lift
Read the latch; dash through as the gate opens.

sections.name: The blossom walk
sections.lesson: Stay low · short hops under the blossom ceiling. Read the latch; dash through as the gate opens.

signs.text:
The blossom walk
Read the latch; dash through as the gate opens.

sections.name: The garden waterfall
sections.lesson: Leave the waterfall onto the dry flower terrace. Read the latch; dash through as the gate opens.

signs.text:
The garden waterfall
Read the latch; dash through as the gate opens.

sections.name: Above the whole garden
sections.lesson: Climb the last switchback and look back over the garden. Read the latch; dash through as the gate opens.

signs.text:
Above the whole garden
Read the latch; dash through as the gate opens.

sections.name: Flowers at the year’s edge
sections.lesson: Link the final bounces to the garden gate. Read the latch; dash through as the gate opens.

signs.text:
Flowers at the year’s edge
Read the latch; dash through as the gate opens.

difficulty.verification_profile: default movement and charge dash, horizontal 1.5, unassisted
